verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scoped API keys with read-only, read-write, or operation-restricted permissions for least-privilege credentials per service or environment, plus role-based access control and Bearer token management via dashboard, directly matching the story. MCP tool docs also show scoped permissions (e.g., database.query.read) required per operation, reinforcing least-privilege agent credentials. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scoped-key issuance workflow and no community corroboration that this feature works as documented in practice.
